basis: Manual close inspection of the supplied screenshot and its unmodified mountain and bridge crops. No historical attribution inferred.

observedCues.observation: The deck rises toward the roofed hall; the two visible approaches have unequal lengths. The pavilion must sit on the highest portion, with a level floor and symmetric roof wings.
observedCues.response: Narrower bank crossing, 5.6-unit rise, level crown at fraction 0.42, flush hall floor and foundation pilings to water.

observedCues.observation: Small foreground hills overlap taller oblique ridges. Uneven broad crowns, side knuckles and rounded flutes interrupt continuous smooth mountain walls.
observedCues.response: 31 individually hand-read crest profiles registered to the painting view, swept 3D ridges, asymmetric front/back slopes, carved channels, exposed feet and four distant shore layers.

observedCues.observation: Azurite blue gathers at crests and shaded shoulders; green facets, warm ochre breaks and dark ink clefts establish much stronger local contrast than a uniform wash.
observedCues.response: Separate face-oriented mineral fields, cleft pooling, warm breaks, granulated deposits and non-radial downhill strokes.

observedCues.observation: Low far shores overlap with muted warm haze. Tall far-right towers have low saturation and faint green-grey crests.
observedCues.response: Four shore depths and world-space mist, reduced saturation on remote towers, stronger near-range contrast.

observedCues.observation: The supplied photograph has muted blue crests, green facets and warm olive-ochre ground. Face shadows are broken into painted shapes, rather than a single smooth light gradient.
observedCues.response: Curated 11-pixel median samples; softened painted shadow bands; cumulative tonal brush maps, dry lifts and depth-gated edge pooling.

observedCues.observation: Sparse dark trees and clustered grass separate ledges and lower slopes; they should not turn blue crests into a continuous forest.
observedCues.response: 190 smaller rooted mountain trees and short grass on gentle shelves; darker irregular foliage deposits. Exact root contact and road clearance checked against the terrain.

observedCues.observation: The source has broad green shore shelves between the bridge bank and taller right-side mountains; earlier reconstruction crowded this region with high ridges.
observedCues.response: Individually traced leaning ridges with separate foreground hills; source-derived crest placement and inferred depth.

boundary: These are observed form and color cues. The 3D scene interprets unseen depth and is not an exact reconstruction.
